depthRule.rule: single native GLORYS level nearest to 15 m, taken as stored (expected 15.81 m); recorded from the file; no vertical interpolation; no depth search; no best-depth selection; depth sensitivity belongs to TEST-04 only

gateDefinitions.G1: provenance: productId GLOBAL_MULTIYEAR_PHY_001_030 / datasetId cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1D-m recorded from the client request
gateDefinitions.G2: file integrity: SHA-256 and byte size of every acquired file recorded in the manifest and re-verified
gateDefinitions.G3: coordinate integrity: strictly increasing, uniform longitude/latitude axes; latitude within [-90, 90]
gateDefinitions.G4: time axis: strictly increasing, uniform 86400 s daily steps
gateDefinitions.G5: variables uo and vo present, 4-D (time, depth, lat, lon)
gateDefinitions.G6: spatial coverage: the locked ocean box lies inside the acquired grid
gateDefinitions.G7: temporal coverage: daily means bracketing t0 and end on both sides with no gap
gateDefinitions.G8: missingness: masked fraction of uo/vo inside the ocean box recorded (fact only; no fill)
gateDefinitions.G10: release-window stencil: the 2x2 bilinear stencil around every release position is unmasked at the bracketing days of t0 and end
gateDefinitions.G11: reproducibility: quality tool re-run to a temporary directory yields byte-identical outputs (checked by the validator)
